programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Tokka contre le reste du monde
programme.sub-title: Tokka contre le reste du monde
programme.desc: Quand Tokka décide de récupérer son petit, c'est le branle-bas de combat sur Terre. Les Forces de Protection Terriennes décident d'attaquer malgré les mises en garde de Bishop.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: La légende de Tiger Claw
programme.desc: Tiger Claw et sa sœur Alopex ont été enlevés enfants par les Krangs. Le tigre et la renarde sont devenus ennemis. Alopex vole les lames de la vengeance dans un musée pour détruire son frère.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Requiem
programme.desc: Super Shredder teste un nouveau super mutagène concocté par Stockman-mouche, qui se révèle parfait pour sa prochaine mission : exterminer tous ses ennemis sans exception, et sans empathie.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: La fin
programme.desc: Les tortues rendent visite à Karaï à l'hôpital. Elle leur révèle où se trouve la planque de Super Shredder. Il s'agit d'une forteresse high-tech en pleine forêt, défendue par ses footbots et autres sergents.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Le rouleau du Démodragon
programme.desc: Les tortues enquêtent sur une mystérieuse secte qui se réunit dans les égoûts. Tiger Claw a décidé de ressusciter Super Shredder.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: L'épéiste oublié
programme.desc: Tiger Claw ordonne à Kavaxas de ramener Rahzar à la vie, ce qu'il parvient à faire. Il lui dit de reproduire ce prodige avec Shredder. Mais il lui manque un élément essentiel, le Kuro Kabuto.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Le cœur du démon
programme.desc: Kavaxas a besoin du cœur de Shredder pour le ressusciter. C'est Don Vizioso qui s'en est emparé et qui le conserve dans une fiole. Les tortues et Tiger Claw vont tout faire pour le lui reprendre.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: La fin des temps
programme.desc: Shredder prend le pouvoir et détruit le sceau. Kavaxas est libre, il ouvre le portail du Royaume des Ténèbres et les revenants déferlent sur Terre.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Il était une fois Splinter et les tortues...
programme.sub-title: Il était une fois Splinter et les tortues...
programme.desc: Maître Splinter réunit ses quatre fils, pas encore adolescents. Il leur raconte en détail la genèse de leur histoire, et leurs débuts dans les rues hostiles de New York.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: La malédiction de Savanti Romero
programme.desc: Panique le soir d'Halloween : New York est envahi de vrais zombies, vampires et loups-garous. April et Casey sont contaminés.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: La crypte de Dracula
programme.desc: Les tortues veulent tuer Dracula avant que Savanti ne s'en empare. Mais Raph est transformé en vampire et Savanti s'enfuit, emportant avec lui la momie, un loup-garou (le père d'Esméralda), Raph et Dracula.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: La créature du docteur Frankenstein
programme.desc: Les tortues ninja partent en Allemagne en 1818 pour tenter d'arrêter Savanti Roméro, qui veut engager Frankenstein dans son armée. Ils échouent mais grace à Reinette les tortues retournent dans le futur pour une dernière tentative.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Les monstres attaquent
programme.desc: La ville de New York est envahie par des monstres en tous genres. Les tortues, aidées de Reinette, tentent de déjouer le plan de Savanti Romero et de Dracula.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Le choc des mondes, 1ère partie
programme.desc: Un vaisseau se dirige vers la Terre. Le lieutenant Iguissg'ba et le commandant Gazéwroka ont reçu l'ordre de prendre en chasse un mercenaire en cavale, K'Vathrak, qui n'est autre que le Tritonateur.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Le choc des mondes, 2e partie
programme.desc: Mikey a pris une décharge électrique fatale. Dregg débarque sur la planète avec son vaisseau, les tortues tentent par tous les moyens de sauver le monde.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Les aventures des Tortues Ninja (1/3)
programme.desc: Les tortues pensent être parvenues à vaincre leurs anciens ennemis, mais elles vont vite s'apercevoir qu'un nouveau mal est à l'œuvre.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Les aventures des Tortues Ninja (2/3)
programme.desc: À la recherche du Kuro Kabuto, Karaï se prétend héritière légitime du Clan des Foot quand elle tombe nez à nez avec un vieux rival.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Les aventures des Tortues Ninja (3/3)
programme.desc: L'animosité de Donatello envers Don Vizioso met la mission des tortues en péril.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Yojimbo
programme.desc: Les tortues débarquent dans un monde féodal peuplé d'animaux anthropomorphes.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Osoroshi no Tabi
programme.desc: Après avoir échappé aux soldats de Sumo Kuma, les tortues doivent affronter les Tanukis, des créatures versatiles, et Joroguma, la terrible femme-araignée.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Kagayake ! Kintaro
programme.desc: Il reste quelques étapes aux tortues, à Usagi et à Kintaro, avant de rallier le temple-palais du Bouddha Céleste. Mais prudence, l'emprise de Jei n'est jamais loin...

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Le guerrier des terres dévastées
programme.desc: Une bombe de mutagène a ravagé la Terre. Dans ce futur post-apocalyptique, Raph et Donnie affrontent le Clan des Blaireaux Maraudeurs du Bitume.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Le désert infranchissable
programme.desc: Dans un futur post-apocalyptique, Donnie le robot, Raph et Mira partent à la recherche du Grand Booyakasha qui peut déchiffrer la carte qui mène à Oasis.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Carmageddon
programme.desc: Raph met le cap sur Oasis, poursuivi par Maximus Kong. Le combat s'engage.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: L'apparition des tortues, 1ère partie
programme.desc: Splinter autorise enfin les tortues à remonter à la surface. Elles tentent de secourir une jeune fille mais s'aperçoivent qu'elles ne savent pas se battre en équipe.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: L'apparition des tortues, 2e partie
programme.desc: Les tortues apprennent qu'April et son père sont retenus prisonniers par les Krangs, de méchants extraterrestres déguisés en robots androïdes. Les tortues réussiront-elles à pénétrer dans le repaire de l'ennemi et à combattre en équipe ?

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Caractère de tortue
programme.desc: Raphael perd son sang-froid quand un vieux New-Yorkais fait une vidéo des Tortues Ninja en train de se battre contre les Krangs. Les tortues doivent mettre la main sur cette vidéo avant qu'elles ne tombent entre de mauvaises mains.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Nouvel ami, vieil ennemi
programme.desc: Pour prouver que les tortues ninja peuvent se lier d'amitié avec des humains, Michelangelo se fait un ami sur un réseau social. Mais cet ami est-il digne de confiance ?

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Je crois qu'il s'appelle Baxter Stockman
programme.sub-title: Je crois qu'il s'appelle Baxter Stockman
programme.desc: Lorsque les tortues quittent le repaire contre l'avis de Splinter, elles font la rencontre de Baxter Stockman, un inventeur dérangé vêtu d'une armure de combat.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Tête d'Acier
programme.desc: Las d'utiliser son bô contre la technologie extraterrestre des Krangs, Donatello crée Tête d'Acier, un robot télécommandé, pour se battre à sa place.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Malin comme un singe
programme.desc: En enquêtant sur la disparition d'un scientifique, Donatello et April croisent la route d'un singe au comportement bizarre et découvrent un complot.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Xever la menace
programme.desc: Léo pourrait regretter d'avoir fait preuve de clémence, quand Xever prend en otage le propriétaire d'un restaurant de nouilles chinoises.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Le défi
programme.desc: April reçoit un message alarmant de la part de son père prisonnier. Les tortues et elles partent en mission pour le sauver et empêcher les Krangs de faire exploser une bombe de mutagène en pleine ville.

programme.title: The Journey Within
programme.desc: On day three of Mark Peterson’s South America Upland Slam adventure, the guys are snowed in while waiting to head to La Pampa, where the weather promised to be much better. After a tense wait for the go-ahead to fly out, they finally touched down in La Pampa and headed straight to the field. There, the grasslands and scattered thickets provide the perfect habitat for Bushed Tinamou, known for their elusive nature and penchant for hiding among dense underbrush. Day four is dedicated to hunting these Tinamou, with Mark eager to track them in their natural habitat. On day five, their focus shifts to Pigeons, where they set up decoys along the edge of a cut cornfield. The anticipation of drawing in flocks makes for an incredible hunt and Mark can’t wait to see what the day will bring.

programme.title: Chasin' The Sun
programme.desc: PCB’s white sand beaches are jam-packed with visitors soaking up sun - and surf while Justin and Meredith chase schools of migrating tarpon - just offshore. How often do those two worlds collide?

programme.title: Chasin' The Sun
programme.desc: While releasing a defeated tarpon healthy after an epic battle is the ultimate victory, everything else is measured in heartbreak and degrees of failure. For Justin, putting Ethan on his first silver king requires patience and a tasty diversion by a local chef.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: Illinois isn’t the first state you think about when it comes to waterfowl, but the Wentz Brothers have dialed in some honey holes over the years. On this episode, a slew of waterfowl experts put to the test some of the newest Winchester waterfowl ammunition during the great migration of the Mississippi Flyway in early December. We’ll also head north to the shores of Kodiak Island, Alaska with Chris and Casey Keefer as they push the limits of Winchester’s new Last Call Double Shot on fast-ripping sea ducks. - GUESTS: Zach Wentz (Team Winchester) Nathan Robinson (Winchester Ammunition) Ryan Swaner (Winchester Repeating Arms) Chris Jennings (Ducks Unlimited) Mike Brasher (Ducks Unlimited) Scott Olmsted (American Hunter) Travis Hall (Field & Stream) Chris Keefer (Team Winchester) Casey Keefer (Team Winchester)

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: Col. Nick Nichols from Folds of Honor and Olympic skeet shooter Dania Vizzi are both proud Americans who have represented their country overseas. Col. Nichols commanded the air in the cockpit of a fighter jet for countless missions during his seven combat tours and Dania donned the stars and bars proudly on her shooting vest as an Olympian in Paris. Now with Winchesters in hand, both are in the Midwest whitetail woods during late November during the back end of the rut hoping to connect on a Missouri monarch.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: Spring in Michigan means turkey season is on. In this episode of Winchester Life, the crew returns for Turkey Camp 2025, where changing weather, early mornings, and vocal birds set the tone for the week. After dialing in their setups at the range, the team heads into the field to chase gobblers across hardwoods and open farmland. From patient sits at sunrise to midday moves and carefully planned decoy strategies, each hunt brings new challenges and opportunities. Close encounters, tough conditions, and well-timed shots highlight the grind of spring turkey hunting, as the crew makes the most of every chance in the Michigan woods.

programme.title: Behind The Draw
programme.desc: Mike’s Missouri bowhunting season started with heartbreak when he discovered his #1 target buck dead from EHD. What could have been the end of his season turned into an unforgettable journey. His wife tagged an early-season buck, both of his sons filled their tags, and finally Mike ended the rollercoaster with a big Missouri whitetail of his own.

programme.title: Wild At Heart: Episode 6

programme.title: Wild At Heart: Episode 8
programme.desc: Danny and Alice are concerned about a missing male giraffe but Du Plessis is confident he can find him. He's as good as his word but they're upset to discover Mara lions have killed the giraffe.

programme.title: Wild At Heart: Episode 9
programme.desc: The family frantically dig for Charlotte in the rubble, hoping that somehow she has survived. Rowan arrives and takes charge of the situation, directing them to be more methodical in their rescue efforts.

programme.title: Wild At Heart: Episode 10
programme.desc: Danny and Alice are enjoying being together but agree to keep their relationship under wraps for the moment. However, they're unaware Georgina has heard their every word!

programme.title: Wild At Heart: Episode 1
programme.desc: Danny and Alice's project to re-habilitate a group of circus elephants has been a huge success but now they have too many elephants on Leopard's Den, so they urgently need to move the circus herd to the National Park.

programme.title: Wild At Heart: Episode 2
programme.desc: Leopard's Den is helping to build a new school in the township but when Danny hurts his back he begins to have a crisis about his age. Danny and Alice are surprised when Vanessa comes to them for advice.

programme.title: Wild At Heart: Episode 3
programme.desc: Mara is hosting a beauty pageant and Rowan realises he needs all the publicity he can get. He buys a tiger from a zoo and convinces Alice he plans to rehabilitate it. Alice is enjoying working with her brother and even defends him to Danny.

programme.title: Wild At Heart: Episode 4
programme.desc: Danny and Alice have been preparing a cheetah for release in the wild but for some reason Danny's mind isn't on the job. He's been pre-occupied because he plans to buy a ring and propose to Alice!

programme.title: Wild At Heart: Episode 5
programme.desc: Danny and Alice are taking a well deserved holiday but Olivia's upset to learn they're leaving that day. Angry at missing out on a driving lesson, she decides to take the jeep out on her own.

programme.title: Wild At Heart: Episode 6
programme.desc: Alice is enjoying her new job at Mara even though her animal census has revealed they have a lone male hyena that needs a pack. Du Plessis isn't happy about Alice working for next door.

programme.title: Wild At Heart: Episode 7
programme.desc: Danny's continued estrangement from Alice is really starting to take its toll. Over at Mara, Alice puts on a brave face as she meets Tom Cox, the owner of a rare male black leopard.

programme.title: Wild At Heart: Episode 8
programme.desc: Caroline returns to find that all is not well at Leopard's Den. Danny has been putting a brave face on his ban but his attempts at helping out around the house are getting on everyone's nerves and Alice is finding his back-seat vetting especially hard.

programme.title: Wild At Heart: Episode 9
programme.desc: Danny is delighted to have his veterinary license back again and being back at work is helping to distract him from the impending anniversary of Sarah's death.

programme.title: Wild At Heart: Episode 10
programme.desc: Du Plessis is restless after his heart surgery but the family insist he needs to relax. Meanwhile Danny and Alice are happy to have closed down a zoo down that has been mistreating animals.

programme.title: Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Rani
programme.desc: Gayatri gets her hands decorated with mehandi and she thinks about her future with Indravadhan. Indravadhan, on the other hand, talks to Sulakshana's photographs claiming that soon he would get married to another girl. Indravadhan engraves the letter 'S' on his chest so as to express his deep love for his late wife, Sulakshana. Later, Badi Raani maa and Raj Mata visit Govind Seth's home. Badi Raani maa tells him that she needs to discuss with him about the wedding proposal. What will Badi Raani maa say to Govind Seth? Keep watching to find out.

programme.title: Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Rani
programme.desc: Badi Raani Maa and Raj Mata are at Govind Seth's home. Raj Mata tells Badi Raani Maa that Govind Seth and she have made a deal. Gayatri, who is listening to their conversation from the balcony, is asked not eavesdrop on the elders' conversation. Gayatri then leaves the place and is unable to acknowledge the truth. Govind Seth explains to Badi Raani Maa that the deal that he and Raj Mata have made. Hearing this, Badi Raani Maa is flabbergasted. Will Badi Raani Maa stop Indravadhan and Gayatri's wedding? Keep watching to find out.

programme.title: Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Rani
programme.desc: Kuwar and Kokila work their plan out to hurt Indravadhan emotionally. Kuwar, on the other hand, uses the help of his men to get an explosive coconut into the wedding so as to kill Indravadhan. Badi Raani Maa, on the other hand, finds the guard carrying the explosive coconut and she asks him to give the coconut to her. Later, Indravadhan and Gayatri are all set to reach the mandap but he gets angry on seeing it. Why is Indravadhan angry on seeing the mandap? Keep watching to find out.

programme.title: Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Rani
programme.desc: Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Rani is the story of love, revenge and royalty. Set in 1940s, this period drama tells the story of Gayatri and Rana Indravadan, and their following generations with ever changing backdrops. It has love, tragedy, revenge and also a touch of supernatural plotline.

programme.title: Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Rani
programme.desc: Just when Raj Mata puts the coconut into Gayatri's lap, it accidentally falls down and breaks, revealing a bomb inside. Everybody is shocked to find the bomb and Raj Mata asks Indravadhan to stay away from the bomb. Indravadhan quickly picks up the bomb and just when he is about leave the place to throw the bomb, Gayatri holds his hand. Indravadhan asks Gaytri to leave his hand but the latter claims that her life has now joined his and she would not leave his hand under any circumstance. Indravadhan and Gayatri rush to throw the bomb and shortly after they leave, the guests hear the blast. Kuwar and Kokila grin away hearing the blast sound. Are Indravadhan and Gayatri alright? Keep watching to find out.

programme.title: Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Rani
programme.desc: The wedding of Indravadhan and Gayatri commences successfully but Kokila does not miss a single chance to hurt Indravadhan. She gifts Gayatri some jewelry that once upon a time was gifted to Sulakshana. When Indravadhan picks up the sindhoor to apply it to Gayatri's forehead, he notices the jewelry and remembers his late wife, Sulakshana. Indravadhan remains silent and continues with the rituals. On the other hand, Kuwar, Kokila and their son talk about their loss as they were unable to carry out any of their plans. Just then, Kokila says she would make Gayatri's life miserable. What plan has Kokila in mind? Keep watching to find out.

programme.title: Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Rani
programme.desc: Indravadhan reveals a painting of Gayatri and welcomes her to the Raj family. Raj Mata declares Gayatri to be the Rani of the Raj Mahal. Later, the rituals are performed and Gayatri is asked to carry them out. Kokila, on the other hand, sets a trap for Gayatri by adding nails in the flowers on which she is going to walk. Gayatri walks on the flower bed but does not make a sound of pain. When she leaves the flower bed, her footprints of blood are clearly visible and Kokila claims this to be an omen. What will Indravadhan and Raj Mata's reaction be when they see Gayatri's footprints? Keep watching to find out.

programme.title: Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Rani
programme.desc: Kokila and Kuwar bribe the priest and ask him to convey the fake message that Indravadhan and Gayatri cannot live together for five days. The member of the Raj Mahal are fooled by the priest and Gayatri is asked to live away from Indravadhan for five days. Indravadhan, on the other hand, expresses his anger before the portrait of Sulakshana and claims that his relationship has just been tied up but he has no love for Gayatri. Gayatri, on the other hand, decides to meet Indravadhan and get the 'Sindoor-Daan' ritual completed. Will Indravadhan apply the sindoor to Gayatri's forehead? Keep watching to find out.

programme.title: Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Rani
programme.desc: Gayatri is introduced to the Raj's kitchen and is asked to prepare the supper for Raj's family. Gayatri decides to prepare vegetarian dishes. Kokila learns that Gayatri is going to prepare vegetarian dishes for the supper while the Raj family only has non-vegetarian dishes. Raj Mata learns about this and asks her slaves to change the food that is served to the Raj family. During the supper, Raj Mata praises Gayatri and claims that the food she has prepared is very delicious. Learning that she had just eaten meat, Gayatri starts vomiting. This angers Indravadhan and he leaves the breakfast table. What explanation would Gayatri now give? Keep watching to find out.
